sources.title: PhaiModelLab/Phai-A1-35B-1M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Phai-A1-35B-1M is a model built upon Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, extensively post-trained and optimized for Coding & Agent workloads. The entire post-training pipeline, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), was conducted on Huawei Ascend NPUs.
